title: Shared Models, Selective Trading, and Order Flow
abstract: arXiv:2610.01897v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study whether model diversity survives selection into trading. In synthetic markets with a fixed mixture of three language-model families, news presentation changes their representation among submitted orders. At the announcement round, Qwen's share of submitted orders shifts by 48 percentage points in the financing event, with little change in net order counts. In the workforce-reduction event, Mistral's share shifts by 40 percentage points while net counts reverse sign. Homogeneous populations remove opposing flow when their active decisions share a direction. An analytical decomposition shows why selection can improve or worsen price accuracy even at unchanged aggregate demand sensitivity. The evidence concerns presentation bundles and submitted flow; cleaner replication and a known-value validation are specified prospectively.

translated_title: 共享模型、选择性交易与订单流
translated_abstract: 我们研究模型多样性是否能在进入交易的选择过程中得以保留。在由三个语言模型家族以固定比例组成的合成市场中，新闻的呈现方式会改变它们在提交订单中的代表性。在公告轮次中，融资事件使Qwen提交订单的份额变化了48个百分点，而净订单数量几乎没有变化。在裁员事件中，Mistral的份额变化了40个百分点，同时净订单数量的符号发生反转。当同质化群体的主动决策方向一致时，会消除相反方向的订单流。一个解析分解说明了为什么即使在总需求敏感度不变的情况下，选择仍然可能改善或恶化价格准确性。本证据涉及新闻呈现组合与提交的订单流；更严格的重复实验和已知价值验证已被前瞻性地规划。
tldr: 该论文发现在由多个大语言模型家族组成的合成市场中，新闻呈现方式会显著改变各模型提交订单的份额（最高达48个百分点），并通过解析分解揭示了模型多样性经交易选择后为何可能在总需求敏感度不变的情况下改善或恶化价格准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in synthetic markets with a fixed mixture of LLM families, news presentation shifts models' shares of submitted orders by up to 48 percentage points, and an analytical decomposition explains why selection can improve or worsen price accuracy even at unchanged aggregate demand sensitivity.
